forecast_method: Per-station ordinary least-squares linear trend, demand ~ week, fit weeks 1–8; extrapolate to week 9; no future demand used.

validation.method: For each target week 3–8, fit only earlier weeks and forecast that specific next week; compare to last-observation naive baseline.
validation.interpretation: Six origins only; descriptive, not evidence of general superiority.

optimality_evidence: Exhaustive enumeration of all integer triples within station caps and total stock (31*26*36 upper bound; infeasible triples skipped); minimum objective found. Exact only for stated forecast/objective/constraints.
limitations: Eight observations per station; linear trend is a simple baseline and ignores seasonality/uncertainty.
Penalty and delivery costs treated as supplied deterministic inputs.
No empirical comparison beyond six rolling origins; no contest or real deployment conclusion.
